memory_candidates.content: When a repository already pins a machine-checked baseline (e.g. an axiom-set baseline diffed on every CI run), a new navigation or summary artifact that restates a subset of the pinned declarations should be guarded by a SUBSET ASSERTION against the existing baseline, not by introducing a second parallel baseline. The subset assertion (~15 lines: extract the names the artifact mentions, assert each appears in the existing pin) makes it impossible for the artifact to advertise an unpinned result, while a second baseline doubles the drift surface and creates two sources of truth that can disagree. Detection cue: a task description asking for a 'summary page wired into the existing check so drift fails the build' often reads as 'add a baseline' when the correct reading is 'assert containment in the baseline that already exists'.
